name: weather
description: Agent skills for US weather from the National Weather Service - forecasts, current conditions, alerts and day planning

interface.shortDescription: US forecasts, conditions and alerts from the NWS
interface.longDescription: Answer weather questions about US places from the National Weather Service API: current conditions from the nearest station, the 7-day and hourly forecast, watches and warnings in effect, and an hour-by-hour look at one day with rain, snow and gust totals for deciding whether a plan works. Free and keyless; covers the United States and its territories only.
defaultPrompt: What's the weather in Denver this week?
Is Saturday dry enough to stain the deck?
Are there any weather warnings for Tampa right now?
